name: Countdown leader card
looks: A giant blocky numeral readout sits over a rough, textured ground (brick, concrete, grain), styled like an old cinema countdown leader rather than a clean digital display, with a thin build-log status line above it. It marks a section as in progress with physical, analogue weight.
build: Numeral in a heavy slab/grotesk face filling most of the card over a full-saturation tiled texture. Ticks on a coarse whole-second interval, each tick a hard cut with no easing, reading as a worksite clock rather than an animated UI. A thin progress rule with a sliding marker places the card in a longer sequence.
sound: A mechanical tick on each coarse step, a low ambient rumble under the hold.
prompt: Show a giant blocky countdown or timer numeral over a rough textured ground like brick or concrete, ticking in hard coarse steps rather than smooth animation, with a short build-log style status line above it, so the moment feels physical and unglamorous rather than a slick progress ring.
